description_en: Retrieves the connection authorization code and required resource information for an existing image or application creation task
description_zh: 获取现有镜像或应用制作任务的连接授权码，以及连接所需的资源信息
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-auth-code --task-type IMAGE_MANUAL --resource-type BUILDER --task-id 'tid-bp1example****' --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuthCode

parameters.help_en:
The actual task type. It must match the creation or validation task corresponding to the TaskId. Use the TaskType returned by GetTask. The task must also have connectable creation or validation resources. You cannot obtain an authorization code for distribution or snapshot tasks that do not have connection resources. Valid values:

AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD: automatically create a VHD image
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD: retry VHD image creation
AUTO_CREATE_VHD: automatically create a VHD
RETRY_VHD: retry VHD creation
AUTO_VALIDATE_VHD: automatically validate a VHD
RETRY_VALIDATE_VHD: retry VHD validation
APPLY_VHD_BUILDER: apply for a VHD application recording environment
ADAPT_AUTO: automatically create application adaptation
ADAPT_AUTO_RETRY: retry automatic application adaptation creation
ADAPT_MANUAL: manually create application adaptation
ADAPT_MANUAL_RETRY: retry manual application adaptation creation
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE: create a custom image for cloud desktop
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE_RETRY: retry custom image creation for cloud desktop
IMAGE_MANUAL: manually create an image
IMAGE_MANUAL_RETRY: retry manual image creation
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE: create an image from an instance
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE_RETRY: retry image creation from an instance
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE: distribute an image to multiple regions
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY: retry image distribution
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE: distribute a snapshot to multiple regions
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY: retry snapshot distribution
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK: create a snapshot from a disk
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK_RETRY: retry snapshot creation from a disk
parameters.help_zh:
任务实际类型，必须与 TaskId 对应的制作或验证任务一致。请使用 GetTask 返回的 TaskType；任务还须存在可连接的制作或验证资源，分发或快照任务没有连接资源时不能获取授权码。

可识别的任务类型：

AUTO_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD：自动制作 VHD 镜像。
RETRY_CREATE_IMAGE_VHD：重试 VHD 镜像制作。
AUTO_CREATE_VHD：自动制作 VHD。
RETRY_VHD：重试 VHD 制作。
AUTO_VALIDATE_VHD：自动验证 VHD。
RETRY_VALIDATE_VHD：重试 VHD 验证。
APPLY_VHD_BUILDER：申请 VHD 应用录制环境。
ADAPT_AUTO：自动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_AUTO_RETRY：重试自动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_MANUAL：手动制作应用适配。
ADAPT_MANUAL_RETRY：重试手动制作应用适配。
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE：创建云电脑自定义镜像。
DESKTOP_CUSTOM_IMAGE_RETRY：重试创建云电脑自定义镜像。
IMAGE_MANUAL：手动制作镜像。
IMAGE_MANUAL_RETRY：重试手动制作镜像。
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE：基于实例制作镜像。
IMAGE_FROM_INSTANCE_RETRY：重试基于实例制作镜像。
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE：向多个地域分发镜像。
IMAGE_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY：重试镜像分发。
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE：向多个地域分发快照。
SNAPSHOT_DISTRIBUTE_RETRY：重试快照分发。
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK：基于磁盘创建快照。
SNAPSHOT_FROM_DISK_RETRY：重试基于磁盘创建快照
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to connect to. Valid values:

BUILDER: connect to the creation environment
VALIDATE: connect to the validation environment

The corresponding environment must be created and in a connectable state
parameters.help_zh:
需要连接的资源类型。

BUILDER：连接制作环境。
VALIDATE：连接验证环境。

对应环境必须已创建并处于可连接状态
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the existing creation or validation task. Create the task and confirm that the corresponding resources are available before calling this operation
parameters.help_zh: 已有制作或验证任务的 ID。先创建任务，并确认相应资源已可用，再调用本接口
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The region compatibility parameter. The destination region of the current connection resource is determined by the execution region of the task. You cannot use this parameter to switch the task region. Omit this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 地域兼容参数。当前连接资源的目标地域由任务的执行地域确定，不能使用此参数切换任务地域。建议省略
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to connect to. When specifying this parameter, you must also provide the matching AppVersionId. If omitted, the application configured in the creation or validation environment is used
parameters.help_zh: 需要连接的应用 ID。指定时应同时提供与其匹配的 AppVersionId；省略时使用制作或验证环境所配置的应用
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application version to connect to. This parameter is used together with AppId. This parameter is not the image version ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要连接的应用版本 ID，与 AppId 配套使用。此参数不是镜像版本 ID
parameters.name: app_version_id

schema.description_en: The response to the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. It is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: The business data returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务数据

AccessType.description_en:
The network access type supported by the connection resource. Valid values:

INTERNET: supports Internet access
VPC: supports VPC access
ANY: supports both Internet and VPC access
AccessType.description_zh:
连接资源支持的网络访问类型。

INTERNET：支持互联网访问。
VPC：支持企业专网（VPC）访问。
ANY：互联网和企业专网（VPC）均支持

AppId.description_en: The application ID, used to query the application or unbind the image later
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID，用于后续查询应用或解除镜像绑定

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The delivery group ID of the creation or validation resource. It is used together with the user and application information in this response when connecting
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 制作或验证资源的交付组 ID，连接时与本次响应中的用户及应用信息配套使用

AppVersionId.description_en: The application version ID, used to locate the specified version of the application. This field is not the image version ID
AppVersionId.description_zh: 应用版本 ID，用于定位应用的指定版本。此字段不是镜像版本 ID

AuthCode.description_en:
The authorization code used to connect to the creation or validation resource. It is valid for 180 seconds (3 minutes) from the time of issuance. Use it promptly after obtaining it. Use it together with the user, delivery group, and application information in the same response, and keep it confidential as a connection credential.

Do not reuse the authorization code after it is successfully redeemed. If it has been used or has expired, call this operation again to obtain a new one
AuthCode.description_zh:
用于连接本次制作或验证资源的授权码。自签发起有效期为 180 秒（3 分钟），请获取后及时使用。请与同一次响应中的用户、交付组和应用信息一起使用，并按连接凭证保密。

授权码兑换成功后请勿重复使用；已使用或过期时，请重新调用本接口获取

ProductType.description_en:
The purpose type of the connection resource. Valid values:

ImageBuilder: image or application creation resource
ImageValidate: image or application validation resource
ProductType.description_zh:
连接资源的用途类型。

ImageBuilder：镜像或应用制作资源。
ImageValidate：镜像或应用验证资源

RegionId.description_en: The region ID in this response
RegionId.description_zh: 本次响应中的地域 ID

UserId.description_en: The user ID used when connecting to the creation or validation environment. Use the value returned in this response
UserId.description_zh: 连接制作或验证环境时使用的用户 ID。应使用本次响应返回的值

Message.description_en: The error or result message. It is used to describe the cause when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
